seo.title: Train an AI agent on Google Drive | Steps AI
seo.description: Connect Google Drive to Steps AI so your agent answers customers from your own Google Drive content on WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger and your website.

hero.title: Answer customers from what is already in Google Drive.
hero.body: Connect the documents your team already keeps in Google Drive, such as policies, price lists and guides. Your agent uses them to answer customer questions.
hero.reassurance: Your own content. Connected once. Used by any agent you choose.

useCases.title: What you can do with Google Drive connected.
useCases.intro: Keep your information where your team already maintains it, and let the agent answer from it.

items.title: Answer from your documents
items.body: Policies, guides and FAQs in Drive become answers your agent can give on every channel.

items.title: Keep one source of truth
items.body: Update the document in Drive and the agent works from the new version, with no copy and paste.

items.title: Share across agents
items.body: One connected folder can serve every agent in your workspace.

setup.title: Connect Google Drive in a few minutes.
setup.intro: No code. You sign in to the app once and you choose which agents use it.

items.title: Connect Google Drive
items.body: Open Resources, then Apps, and choose Google Drive. Sign in, or enter your account details, to connect it to your workspace.

items.title: Add it to your agent
items.body: Connecting adds Google Drive to your workspace. Then add it to each agent that should use it. An agent only uses the app once both steps are done.

items.title: Choose what the agent can read
items.body: Pick the pages, files or tables to use. They become workspace resources, so any agent can use them and one edit updates every agent.

goodToKnow.title: Good to know
items: The agent answers from the content you choose. Keep it up to date and the answers stay up to date.
Storage and processing limits depend on your plan.

faq.title: Questions about the Google Drive integration.

items.q: Does the agent use everything in my account?
items.a: No. You choose what to connect, and the agent uses only that.

items.q: Can several agents use the same content?
items.a: Yes. Connected content is a workspace resource, so you set it up once and any agent can use it.

items.q: What if a question is not covered?
items.a: The agent can say it does not know and pass the conversation to your team. Web search is optional and off unless you switch it on.

cta.title: See Steps AI work with Google Drive.
cta.body: Book a demo and we will walk through a real conversation using Google Drive and your own information.
